description: Stratum step postcondition. Stratum specs declare `ensure: ['result.unsuppressed_violations == 0']` — the policy check exposes `unsuppressed_violations` in the step result (contract-gated: attached when the step's out contract declares it or has no contract). Corrected 2026-08-17: the originally-proposed `compose.policy.*` ensure namespace does not exist; ensure is evaluated by the external Stratum engine against `result.<field>` only.
